prompt:
Create one finished native editable SVG opening composition for a future Emberwake story study, An Empty Target. This is one still reference plate, not a comic, sprite sheet, animation or UI. Landscape 1280 by 896, viewBox="0 0 1280 896". Fixed orthographic game-story camera, slightly elevated three-quarter view, with all action on one ground plane. A quiet ruined stone courtyard, one living heroine at the left, one small incoming fire projectile at the right, and generous unoccupied floor beyond the projectile toward the far right. Tell the moment through gaze, distance and readable negative space.

HERO IDENTITY AND GESTURE: Exactly one Mira, the last lantern scholar, a slender adult sorceress. Full figure around x=310, from hood near y=330 to firmly planted boots near y=720. Her body and warm human face turn attentively to the right toward the approaching fire spell. A fitted blue hood frames dark hair and a small warm face with a restrained alert expression. The cyan cape sweeps back to her left in one asymmetrical cloth gesture; it is attached at her shoulders, not a detached ribbon. She wears a fitted blue split coat with diagonal open hems, dark trousers and two distinct practical boots. A narrow aged brass belt crosses the fitted waist. Separate the two coat tails so they read as cloth over legs. Keep shoulders, bent elbows, wrists and hips connected and proportionate. The left free hand is held slightly away from her waist, fingers together, with just a tiny restrained cold-cyan cue near the palm. No large spell disc or portal. The other hand visibly grips her upright bronze staff on the viewer-right side of her body. The entire straight staff runs down to the same ground plane as her feet, with a small open bronze crescent at its top surrounding a tiny warm lantern ember. The crescent's negative space must be clearly readable. Keep all staff, head, cape hem and both boots fully inside the frame with comfortable margins. The staff is slender aged metal, not a spear, trident, tree branch or oversized ceremonial moon. Her weight rests over one planted foot, the other braces slightly behind; her cape answers the gesture. No airborne pose.

SPATIAL STORY CONTRACT: One fire missile only, at about x=830 to 940, y=485, traveling horizontally LEFT toward Mira's current position. Its compact orange core and tapered flame tail extending to its RIGHT must make leftward travel unambiguous. The fire spell is in free space ahead of Mira; it has not hit her and is not emitted by her staff. It should be small relative to her body, bright enough to read at phone scale, with a short controlled tail rather than a screen-filling fire serpent. The unoccupied floor around x=1080 to 1160, on the same depth plane as Mira's boots, is the future clear landing area BEHIND the left-moving projectile. Show only quiet bare slabs there: no second Mira, ghost, silhouette, destination marker, ring, portal, reticle or diagram. Leave the line of sight and floor path between the present position and that space unobstructed. The unseen hostile caster remains offscreen right. No acolyte or other character in this plate. This is only the opening before a possible later teleport: do not depict the teleport, split her identity, give her invulnerability or show an impact. Exactly one complete heroine and exactly one fire missile.

ENVIRONMENT, MATERIAL AND LIGHT: Match Emberwake's existing quiet slate crypt language with broad joined masonry, a few shallow floor slab seams, a low ruined chapel wall far behind the action and at most one subdued broken stone pier near the rear edge. Use charcoal-slate #28333c shadows, #39444d midplanes, cool gray #53626a edges; three broad value groups. Keep the ground under both Mira and the future landing space visible, calm and evenly legible. No central altar, graveyard object suite, new equipment, ornamental arch portal or giant moon. Soft upper-left light describes stone thickness. Ground contact shadows touch the soles and staff tip. Hero hood and fitted coat use dark blue #1e455f and #387f9c; cyan cloth #75cfe7, pale restrained highlights #b6e2de; aged bronze #91764e with sparse #d6bd7d edges. Cold cue #99eaff stays tiny. Projectile #ff9952 with a compact pale warm core. Preserve the heroine as the dominant form; the projectile is the secondary focus. Do not bathe the whole courtyard in blue or orange bloom.

DRAWING AND DELIVERY: Cohesive expressive fantasy illustration with connected curved anatomy and broad engraved planes. A specific alert gesture, clear silhouette, fitted cloth, believable support and useful negative space come before surface detail. Use quiet dark contours and selective cuts, not a heavy outline around every small shape. Keep this readable as one scene at 640 by 448 and 320 by 224: the blue hood, swept cyan cape, split coat, brass belt, upright bronze crescent staff, two supported feet, left-moving orange missile and clear empty right floor must survive reduction. No photorealism, glossy plastic, chibi proportions, masked faceless token, extra limbs, duplicate staffs, text, captions, arrows, panels, game HUD, logo, frame or watermark. Deliver only self-contained static native SVG vector paths and shapes, with no embedded raster image, external resources, scripts or animation. Use simple separable scene groups if possible, without adding visible labels. Preserve a stable composition that can later serve as a text-guided still reference for two short connected GIF clips.
